listenings.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to the Old Town Guesthouse. My name is Elena and I work here at the front desk. I am from Ljubljana, but I live in Dubrovnik now. Breakfast starts at seven o'clock every morning, on the terrace upstairs. The old town is a ten minute walk from the door, and the cathedral opens at nine. If you want a good local restaurant, just ask me. I know every kitchen in this street. Enjoy your stay.

Welcome to your audio guide. You are standing in front of the old city walls. People built these walls more than six hundred years ago, and today they are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Walk slowly and look at the stone. Every colour tells you something about the century. On your left you see the cathedral, and behind it the narrow streets of the old town. This city is a museum with no doors. Take your time, and enjoy the journey.

extra_audio.text: Ricardo arrives at the guesthouse and says good afternoon. He tells Elena his name and where he is from. He explains that he is an architect from Sao Paulo. Elena asks him what he wants to see first. Ricardo says he loves old buildings, and he asks her for a good restaurant.
